example_sentences_in_bangla: সে রাজা তেজচন্দ্রের মতো অত্যন্ত দর্পী হয়ে উঠেছে।
অফিসে তার আচরণ দেখে মনে হয় সে রাজা তেজচন্দ্র।
example_sentences_in_english: He has become extremely arrogant like King Tejchandra.
His behavior at the office makes him seem like King Tejchandra.
history: From Bengali folklore: The king of Bardhaman, Tejchandra, was known for his extreme arrogance.
note: This idiom draws from a specific historical anecdote in Bengali oral traditions.
